test_item_verbatim: The Rear View Camera can be manually activated via the controls page,

tcs.tc_title: manual activation via the controls page
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The shift lever is in P
4. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. PENDING: DR-CAM-g open the Controls screen
2. Select the Rear View Camera soft control on the Controls screen
3. Read the HU display and check that the rear view camera image is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. PENDING: DR-CAM-g the Controls screen is displayed
2. The Rear View Camera soft control registers the selection
3. The rear view camera image is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: manual activation via the controls page
tcs.test_item:
The Rear View Camera can be manually activated via the controls page,

(manual activation via the controls page)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 §6.5.1 三入口之 controls page 一支。verbatim 為該列 Description 之保序子序列（刪 `, apps drawer, or camera app`，**profile §5** 之摘句）。Controls 頁之進入路徑於 SYS1 匯出無逐字來源 → **DR-CAM-g**，沿 batch01b（`NR1L-RVC-034` 等五列）之形制。`Controls screen` 為 H 本 §12.2.1.1.3 與 R 本 §7.2.5 之逐字用語，非自造。互參 A 本 `SWE-CAM-016`（crossref `precondition-or-hop`）。
